description: This file defines the LessBinary class, which represents the less-than ('<') binary operation node in the Twig template engine's expression tree. It includes methods for compiling the node into executable code, with special handling for different PHP versions.

classes.name: LessBinary
classes.description: A class representing the less-than ('<') binary comparison operation within the Twig template engine's expression node hierarchy.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the less-than operation, with special handling for PHP 8.0 and above to delegate to the parent class's compile method, otherwise generating a comparison expression.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator symbol ('<') that this node represents.
